The '''2000–01 season''' was [[Real Madrid C.F.|Real Madrid]]'s 70th season in [[La Liga]]. This article lists all matches that the club played in the 2000–01 season, and also shows statistics of the club's players.

== Summary ==
This was the season where the club won its 28th [[2000–01 La Liga|La Liga]] title, having begun a new policy of signing the world's greatest players under a new president, [[Florentino Pérez]], with a goal of making Real Madrid the most fashionable club in the world. [[Luís Figo]] was the arrival of the year, along with [[Claude Makélélé]], and they helped a team of stars, dubbed the ''[[galácticos]]'', win the league under [[Vicente del Bosque]], as well as reaching the [[2000–01 UEFA Champions League|UEFA Champions League]] semi-finals as defending champions, where they were narrowly knocked out by [[FC Bayern Munich|Bayern Munich]]. The arrival of [[Luís Figo]] in July 2000 was controversial due to his move from [[FC Barcelona|Barcelona]] to Real Madrid, thus generating furious reactions from Barcelona fans and also [[Boixos Nois]] hooligans.
